* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “During battle at a site with R2-D2, may not be targeted by weapons, and may draw one destiny; subtract that amount from opponent’s total power. Once per game, may place all your non-[Immune to Alter] Effects on table in Used Pile.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “During battle” to “During a battle”. PC-E1 text: “During a battle at a site with R2-D2, may not be targeted by weapons, and may draw one destiny; subtract that amount from opponent's total power. Once per game, may place all your non-Immune to Alter Effects on table in Used Pile.”<ref name="cl-1210_92">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
